generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small top-down 2D gameplay pickup sprite for Survival Arena. Create one healing potion pickup. Match the references' hand-painted dark plum outline, simplified shapes, warm textured shading, and readable game-sprite finish. Genuinely transparent background. A single squat round glass bottle filled with rich green healing liquid, short cork neck and small cream cloth tie, clearly distinct from experience blue. Rustic fantasy 3/4 top-down gameplay view, centered on a square canvas, object fills about 68%, generous clean transparent padding. One object only; readable around 32 pixels; continuous clean outline; no medical cross, text, UI frame, particles, cast shadow or watermark. Avoid poison skulls, neon sci-fi styling, tall narrow bottle, thin protrusions and photorealism.
